title: Add Codex CLI support
description: Add Codex CLI as a Staffed agent integration. Verify the current Codex agent/subagent format, canonical user and project paths, discovery mechanism, model controls, and activation behavior against a real install before enabling support. Extend agent selection and detection, rendering, lifecycle ownership, documentation, and tests. Deliver as its own reviewed commit before starting OpenCode support.

title: Add OpenCode support
description: Complete and verify the existing OpenCode integration after Codex CLI support is committed. Confirm the current agent format, canonical paths, discovery and activation behavior, model and profile constraints, and real-host lifecycle safety before enabling support. Update detection, documentation, and tests, then deliver as a separate reviewed commit.

title: Clarify agent and model installation docs
description: Update the README installation and quickstart guidance so users can clearly choose (1) the target agent integration with --agent, such as --agent pi versus --agent claude, and (2) the independently selected model profile with --profile, such as --profile openai versus --profile claude. Include practical command examples for common combinations, explain auto-detection and when --agent must be explicit, list currently available/supported agent targets and model profiles (including inherit/none behavior), and make clear that agent choice controls file format/destination while profile choice controls rendered model aliases. Keep the README Install section and quickstart flow consistent with CLI behavior and current support gates.

title: Build navigable pi-staffed TUI
description: Replace /staffed-runs notification output with the responsive, keyboard-navigable list/detail overlay specified in the linked plan. Preserve standard-event-only observability and honest async launch semantics. Target repository: /home/soleone/src/pi/pi-staffed.
